svg.title: mujoco-puzzle-gym
svg.desc: Pixel-art banner: Claude types a room.yaml at a terminal and each line adds a piece to a top-view puzzle room (walls with an opening, a yellow floor switch, a door, a blue goal and the link between them); after a green check, a small duck robot walks onto the switch, which turns green and slides the door open, then walks through to the goal while the terminal prints success 0.99 and Claude nods.
